⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The washer starts sensing, hums quietly at the top rear, fails to reach the target water level within 8 minutes, and beeps with code IE.

Verified technical root cause: Failed solenoid coil or clogged diaphragm on the multi-solenoid cold water inlet valve assembly.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Turn off the wall water taps, unscrew the cold and hot hoses from the back of the washer, and clean the fine mesh sediment screens inside the valve ports.
  2. If water flow into the detergent drawer is still weak or stops during the rinse cycle with code IE, replace the 5221ER1003A inlet valve right under the top lid.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Error IE (Water Inlet Error))

Why does Error IE pop up right at the Rinse cycle after the wash cycle worked fine?
The 5221ER1003A valve has 4 separate solenoid coils (Main Wash, Pre-wash, Bleach, and Fabric Softener/Rinse). When the Rinse coil burns out, the washer fills fine at the start but throws IE as soon as it tries to flush the fabric softener compartment.
